name: What is the step-by-step process of framing a new partition wall?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process of framing a new partition wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partition wall framing begins by snapping chalk lines on the floor and transferring them to the ceiling joists with a plumb bob or laser level to ensure vertical alignment. Bottom and top plates are cut together to mark stud spacing at either 16 or 24 inches on center. After securing plates to floor and ceiling joists, vertical studs are fastened, rough door openings are framed with king studs and jack studs, and solid horizontal blocking is added for wall stability and fixture mounting. Once inspection or rough-ins finish, drywall and trim follow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors align top and bottom plates using laser levels, fasten plates to structural framing, install vertical studs with door openings and blocking, then prepare bays for utilities.
